summary.zh-CN: 激活函数是神经网络中处理计算结果的一类函数。不同函数可以截断、压缩或平滑地调整数值。它们提供的非线性响应与加权计算配合，让网络能够表达更复杂的关系。
summary.en-US: An activation function processes the result of a computation inside a neural network. Different functions can clip, compress, or smoothly adjust values. Their nonlinear response works with weighted computation so the network can express more complex relationships.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 加权计算组合信息，非线性激活改变响应方式；不同激活函数用不同的曲线实现这一作用。
coreConclusion.en-US: Weighted computation combines information; nonlinear activation changes the response. Different activation functions implement this role with different curves.
